result:
US-010 was already built and committed, so this run only did the one thing left: the frozen browser tests.

I rebuilt the stack so it ran the new code, then ran AC-010-08, 09 and 10. All 9 runs pass (3 tests × Chromium, Firefox and WebKit).

The story is still "in progress" and DoD-S-01 is still not met. EX-010-04 (a trashed contact isn't listed) needs the Trash endpoint from US-012, and E2E-03 and E2E-04 need export and Trash too. A test I wrote covers EX-010-04 with a contact trashed directly in the database.

I updated `docs/00_progress.md` and committed (`a099eac`). The next command it points to is `/implement US-012`.
